title: Installing with --only-shell or --no-shell, then launching in the other mode, fails with Executable doesn't exist
symptoms: Executable doesn't exist at .../chromium-1208/chrome-linux64/chrome after npx playwright install --only-shell
Executable doesn't exist at .../chromium_headless_shell-1208/... after npx playwright install --no-shell
Headed debugging or channel: 'chromium' breaks on a CI image that runs headless tests fine
cause: Playwright ships two Chromium builds: a headless shell for default headless runs and a full build for headed runs and the 'chromium' channel. Each flag skips one of them.
fix: Match the install flag to how tests launch. Use --only-shell only when every run is headless with no channel, and --no-shell only when you set channel: 'chromium'.
apply:
# default headless only
npx playwright install --with-deps --only-shell chromium
# headed, or use: { channel: 'chromium' }
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
affected: Playwright 1.49 and later (separate headless shell build)
